command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses an undefined write but treats all missing inputs as preventing review; the operation is identifiable and can be packaged without editing Master.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After baseline and fresh approval, use the protected target-approved equivalent of `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x29 <four-byte-little-endian-time>` once, then perform an independent Get SDR Repository Time readback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master attended time 10, machine time 5 and TBD content are retained; no default timestamp is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture repository/SEL time evidence, validate exact epoch and shared-clock behavior, execute one confirmed set, read back and restore only under an approved chronology-aware plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a bounded Review-layer transaction while preserving the original TBD source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback alone is partial evidence and cannot replace the required Set SDR Repository Time operation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing repository time can invalidate chronology and may also move SEL time; restoration does not erase misleading intermediate timestamps.

project_override_considerations: A vendor utility or management API is acceptable when it targets the same repository clock and proves equivalent encoding, write, readback and shared-clock effects. Its success does not validate raw 0x0a/0x29 unless that coverage is explicitly waived.
expected_evidence: Fresh approval and exact target epoch/time basis
Pre-write SDR/SEL raw and decoded times plus repository evidence hash

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a clock mutation, but Master Procedure/Criteria are TBD and its generic log-clear step would destroy relevant chronology evidence. DeepSeek supplies no executable path; the Review layer must define a bounded write without overwriting source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose and candidate standard operation are understood. The exact timestamp, firmware schema, approval and restoration policy are Project execution-readiness inputs, not an irreducible semantic blocker.

review_improvement: Preserves functional set-time coverage while adding evidence retention, exact encoding, shared-clock assessment, readback and no-retry controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: A repository-time write can affect audit ordering even when the command succeeds. The acceptance oracle therefore requires the exact encoded value, independent readback and explicit analysis of SEL clock coupling; because those inputs can be supplied before execution, the correct classification is confirmation/package rather than BLOCKED.
